column1: # CHAOS-11105 measured wall time of the slow top-level internal/providersync tests, for the integration shard plan.
# Format: TestName<TAB>seconds (a number, at most two decimals), sorted by name (C locale), one row per test.
# ci/check_go.sh weighs a listed test by these seconds (in 10 ms units) and an unlisted test by its class weight in
# ci/go_providersync_test_shards.tsv (integration-test-weight 200 = 2 s; ordinary-test-weight 1 = 10 ms), then assigns
# the tests to shards by longest-processing-time-first. Only tests that run 5 s or more are listed.
# The plan fails if a row names a test that no longer exists, if one test is over 75% of the shard's go test timeout
# (990 s; one test cannot be split), or if a planned shard is over that same 990 s budget.
# Refresh (when a shard's job time drifts toward the cap, or after adding a slow test):
#   1. Download the per-test logs of 3 recent successful main runs of go.yml:
#   2. Mean the Elapsed of every top-level pass event over the runs, keep the tests of 5 s or more, sort by name:
#          | awk -F'\t' '{s[$1]+=$2; n[$1]++} END {for (k in s) if (s[k]/n[k] >= 5) printf "%s\t%.2f\n", k, s[k]/n[k]}' \
#   3. Replace the rows below, run `ci/check_go.sh integration-shard-plan`, and commit the result.
